articles.title: Sundar Pichai's Alphabet Just Sold $80 Billion in Stock. It Still Won't Be Enough.

For NRI investors holding GOOGL, the calculus between dilution and growth just got more urgent.

articles.nri_angle: Indian IT stocks are among the most widely held equities in NRI portfolios. articles.title: Intel Just Shipped Its Most Advanced Chip Ever. Nobody Noticed.
articles.excerpt: The Clearwater Forest Xeon 6+ is built on 18A — the first 2nm-class processor manufactured in the United States. But Jensen Huang stole the show.
articles.nri_angle: Intel employs tens of thousands of Indian engineers across its Bangalore R&D campus and US design centres. Its Odisha substrate investment and the 18A manufacturing revival directly shape career trajectories and India's semiconductor ambitions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic Is Now Worth More Than OpenAI. Its CFO Is Indian-Origin. Its IPO May Be Months Away.
articles.excerpt: A $65 billion Series H values the Claude maker at $965 billion. For NRI investors and AI professionals, the real question is what happens in October.
articles.nri_angle: Anthropic's CFO Krishna Rao is of Indian origin. The company just expanded into Bengaluru. An October IPO would be the first trillion-dollar AI listing — directly relevant to NRI investors, Indian AI researchers considering offers, and the diaspora professionals building on Claude.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Startups Raised $66 Million Last Week. Anthropic Raised $65 Billion. Read That Again.
articles.excerpt: The last week of May was the worst for Indian startup funding in 2026. The gap with global AI companies is no longer a gap — it is a chasm.
articles.nri_angle: NRI founders debating whether to build in India or the US face a stark funding reality. Indian investors are sitting out the AI wave. For diaspora professionals sending capital or talent back home, the structural deficit in Indian AI requires honest assessment.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AMD Just Put the First 2nm Server Chip Into Production. Its Stock Has Doubled This Year.
articles.excerpt: Venice, AMD's next-generation EPYC processor built on TSMC's most advanced process, marks a milestone in the data centre wars — and a turning point for NRI investors tracking the semiconductor rally.
articles.nri_angle: AMD's 125% YTD stock rally directly affects NRI investors with US tech exposure through direct holdings, 401(k)s, and index funds. TSMC's Arizona fab, where Venice will also be manufactured, is recruiting heavily from India's IITs. The Indian semiconductor diaspora is gaining new career pathways in US-based chip manufacturing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Qualcomm Dropped 7.5% the Morning Nvidia Entered Its Market. Twenty Thousand Indian Engineers Are Watching.
articles.excerpt: Nvidia's RTX Spark superchip turned Computex into a reckoning for Qualcomm's Arm PC ambitions — and for the massive Indian workforce in San Diego that built them.
articles.nri_angle: Qualcomm's San Diego HQ and India R&D centres employ tens of thousands of Indian-origin engineers, many on H-1B visas. Nvidia's entry into the Windows-on-Arm market directly threatens Qualcomm's PC chip division, creating workforce uncertainty for H-1B holders with 60-day grace period constraints. NRI investors in QCOM face a repricing event.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NVIDIA and TSMC Are Now Using AI to Make AI Chips. India's Fabs Should Be Taking Notes.
articles.excerpt: TSMC has deployed Nvidia's CUDA and AI systems inside its own fabrication lines, accelerating lithography by 25x. For India's nascent semiconductor mission, this sets the technology bar.
articles.nri_angle: India's semiconductor mission — Micron Sanand, Tata Dholera, Intel Odisha — must eventually match the AI-assisted manufacturing capabilities TSMC is deploying. Indian engineers at TSMC Arizona are learning these systems firsthand. The diaspora talent pipeline between US fabs and India's future facilities is a critical knowledge transfer channel.
